# HallwaySync

> Real-Time In-Person & Hybrid Tech Event Networking and Team Formation application powered by Supabase Realtime, PostgreSQL, React 18, and TypeScript.

HallwaySync bridges the physical hallway track at hackathons, developer conferences, and builder summits with frictionless digital team formation. Organizers project a dynamic stage QR code. In-person attendees scan with their smartphone cameras to onboard in under 45 seconds without downloading an app or creating a password. Attendees discover complementary teammates, send reciprocal connection waves, scan physical badges, and unlock direct contact handles (Telegram, LinkedIn) upon mutual connection.

## Core Capabilities & Endpoints

- [HallwaySync Live App](https://vite.sharukhtech.com/): Instant room creation and live event networking hall.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/shaikhsharukh/HallwaySync): Complete open source codebase, PostgreSQL schemas, and real-time event protocols.
- [Robots Policy](https://vite.sharukhtech.com/robots.txt): Crawler and agent indexation guidelines.
- [Sitemap](https://vite.sharukhtech.com/sitemap.xml): Primary canonical search index.

## Key Features

- **Instant Room Creation**: Organizers launch networking halls in 1 click with quickstart presets (Hackathon, Cloud Summit, Builders Meetup).
- **Stage & Projector Presentation Mode**: High-contrast, projection-optimized QR code display with live attendee counters.
- **45-Second Onboarding**: Anonymous Supabase authentication with 3-step profile setup (Identity, Skills, Intent).
- **Privacy-First Asymmetric Reveal**: Contact handles remain confidential until mutual reciprocal waves or camera badge scans occur.
- **Physical QR Badge Scanner**: Mobile camera scanner supporting the `hallwaysync:badge:` handshake protocol.
- **Organizer Live Command Center**: Real-time demographic charts, live attendee moderation, and instant stage announcement broadcasts.

## Tech Stack & Architecture

- **Frontend**: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React
- **Backend**: Supabase (PostgreSQL 15, Row-Level Security, Security Definer RPCs)
- **Realtime**: Supabase Realtime Channels (Broadcast announcements and presence radar)
